notes: Document covers a BiDi transceiver pair: SO-SFP-1000Base-BX60D-34 (TX/RX 1310/1490 nm) and SO-SFP-1000Base-BX60D-43 (TX/RX 1490/1310 nm). Nominal wavelength Tx/Rx: 1310nm/1490nm and 1490nm/1310nm. Operating temperature options: 0°C to +70°C (C-temp) or -40°C to +85°C (I-temp, ordering -I). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Power budget 8 – 27dB. Protocol support includes FE, GbE, and 1G FC. Transmitter output power min/max and receiver min input power, overload are average power (footnote 3). Receiver minimum input power -27.0 dBm and overload -3.0 dBm at 1.25Gbps, BER ≤ 1x10-12, PRBS 27-1, back-to-back (footnote 4). Wavelength ranges footnote 1) SO-SFP-1000Base-BX60D-34; footnote 2) SO-SFP-1000Base-BX60D-43. Power consumption stated as < 1.0W.
